introHtml: PCNA lanyards and badges combine the trusted quality of PCNA manufacturing with your custom branding. Whether you need durable woven lanyards for daily ID badges or antimicrobial options for healthcare settings, PCNA offers a range of styles from 3/8" knit-in to 1" knit-in and PVC plastic. These lanyards hold up to frequent use, making them ideal for corporate events, conferences, and employee identification programs. Choose full-color imprinting to display your logo prominently.
